svg.title: Apache platform supports independent applications while AGPL covers the integrated Scriberig product
svg.desc: The Apache-2.0 reusable platform sits in the center. One branch leads to a third-party proprietary application, marked as permitted without adopting the Scriberig product license. Another branch leads to the integrated Scriberig server, editor, and agent runtime under AGPL-3.0, then to a modified hosted service whose covered modifications remain subject to AGPL source-availability obligations. Dependency arrows show the AGPL product may depend on Apache platform libraries, while reusable platform libraries should not depend on the integrated product.
svg.text: One permissive platform, two legitimate product paths
store · graph · adapters · protocol · SDKs · UI primitives
may be proprietary or use another license
uses Apache platform without becoming Scriberig product
product layer intentionally depends on platform
covered AGPL modifications remain subject to AGPL obligations
The license follows architectural responsibility, not whether code is a library or binary.
platform should not depend upward on integrated product
